note: Chapter 1 is keyed from 'Signori flicks' (the flick) through 'Roberto Baggio' (he collects), 'The keeper rushes out', 'Baggio goes round' to 'goal' (the ball crossing the line): keep the pauses at '...' so the run plays near real time. Chapter 3 continues the sentence chapter 2 leaves hanging.

chapters.label: The goal, live
chapters.text: Boston, 1994. Italy and Spain are level, two minutes left. Signori flicks it through, and Roberto Baggio runs clear! The keeper rushes out... Baggio goes round him... goal!

chapters.label: Watch it again
chapters.text: Watch it again, slowly. Baggio stays calm and takes the ball wide, around keeper Zubizarreta. It runs a little too far...

chapters.label: Tight angle
chapters.text: But from a tight angle, past a defender on the line, he passes it into the net. Italy are into the semi-final!

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn: one-on-one with the keeper? Stay calm, take it around them, and pass it into the net.
